name: What are common signs of a shower leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a shower leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a shower leak include water stains on the ceiling or walls adjacent to the shower, peeling paint or wallpaper near the shower, a musty odor indicating mold or mildew growth, dripping sounds even when the shower is off, or loose tiles and grout in the shower area. Increased water bills without a change in usage can also be an indicator of a hidden leak. Addressing these signs early can prevent more extensive damage to your home's structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, peeling paint, musty odors, dripping sounds, or loose tiles. An unexplained increase in your water bill can also indicate a leak.
